description: Canal-belt cornice house of the 18th c. without an attic frieze (Keizersgracht 258, 248): a 5.5-9 m front of brick (dark brown or painted) or white stucco, a tall ground storey of door and windows at street level and three upper storeys of three axes of white-framed 2-over-2 sashes in broad white frames, under a plain white cornice at the eaves

match.note: Keizersgracht 258 (169386), 2021-01-22 strip at 40 px/m: ground openings 1.9-5.0 m, rows 6.0-8.6, 9.0-11.0, 11.5-13.0 m, white cornice 14.5-15.2 m; the type is pinned per pand from the strip (review-types)

door-left.note: the house door at street level on the left axis; a door on the right is mirrored

roof.evidence: Keizersgracht 258 (2021-01-22 strip): sky over the plain cornice from the quay; no roof face shows, so the front gives a flat top at the cornice

rhythm.groundFloor: door and tall windows at street level
schemaLimits: the iron balconettes of the first floor are not drawn
the broad eared white frames are drawn as plain full frames
